title: Edit Customer checks the name only after typing or on Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create customer A for this test.
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
  2. Click the Credit Terms dropdown.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Clear the Customer Name.
  5. Click the Credit Limit field.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Customer window for customer A opens.

Step 2:

  • No name message shows.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown closes.

Step 4:

  • The Name field is empty.

Step 5:

  • The message "Customer name is a required field" shows.

Step 6:

  • The customer is not saved and the message still shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S5-R10: “The Name field on New Customer and Edit Customer is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave it) or presses Save with no name, because it used to show an error before the user had typed anything, as soon as they clicked another field such as Credit Terms. See Story 11: Release day (S11-R6).”
  • S11-R6: “New Customer and Edit Customer no longer show "Customer name is a required field" as soon as the window opens and another field is clicked, which showed an error before the user had typed anything. The name is checked once the user has typed in it and leaves the field, or when they press Save with no name.”
